descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-09 All Residents Attendance Toggle (Nursing Home only) · S16 「同一个医生的另一台设备（包括时钟和时区都错的那台）实时显示同样的出勤」 Another device of the same physician, including one with a wrong clock and time zone, shows the same attendance, live

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • T1 Attendance state persists correctly per day, by server time. On the same day a mark survives a reload, navigation and other devices. The day boundary follows the server clock, not the device clock.（TFA-92587 AC 6；UAT 3.8）
  • U5 Marking 'In Today' puts the resident on the Today's Visits tab. Un-marking removes them from today without deleting them: they stay in All Residents.（UAT TC-09；TFA-92587 AC 2；TFA-92587 How it works 2；TFA-92587 How it works 6）

测试设计方法：状态迁移（state-transition） — 按先后顺序走（加 → 改 → 删、第 1 天 → 第 2 天、离线 → 在线），每一步之后看状态对不对。

Given Browser A (normal clock) on Today's Visits with the fixture resident on it. Browser B: a second context of the same physician with page.clock fixed at server day D+2 and timezoneId 'Pacific/Kiritimati'

When B un-marks the resident, then marks it again; A is not reloaded. Then A and B each show Today's Visits, All Residents and the Nursing Home dashboard

Then A drops the resident, then shows them again, without a reload. A and B list the same residents with the same toggle states, and their dashboard numbers match (UAT 3.8: a wrong clock or time zone shows the same state)

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：oracle.mjs: s16-after-unmark has no {snfResident}; s16-after-mark has it (T1 across devices). B's checkpoints hold the same absolute expectations as A's final state: Today's Visits has the resident and no 'In Today ✓', All Residents has the resident and 'In Today ✓', and both dashboards show counts Total 1 / Pending 1 (3.8)

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 MULTI · 多端 / 多账号；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（blocked）

S16 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-09.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：MULTI · 多端 / 多账号；辅助：PW · Playwright 脚本 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev。
